title: devx-hacklist-tutorial-snag-notes
content:
Morning quick dump - things I ran into while pairing with Lina on the Node tutorial (local run-through).

Context: pairing session to verify 'build-a-chat-app' tutorial + sample app works on macOS + Docker. Found several tiny but blocking gaps that will trip users on first run. This file = scratchpad of action items + notes-to-self.

Top priorities (blocking for launch):
- [ ] Tutorial 3: 'start-local' script failing (node version mismatch). error: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'" when running sample-server/index.mjs. Likely docs show package.json with "type": "module" removed. Need to:
    - update tutorial step to require Node >= 18 (add check in script)
    - push tiny patch to sample-app package.json so examples are copy-pasteable (PR: sdk-node #412 linked).
- [ ] Missing env var descriptions in quickstart: REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_PRIVATE_KEY. Users confused which to use for Hosted vs Dedicated. Add clarifying paragraph + table.
- [ ] Streaming example: snippet uses client.responses.stream but SDK exports responses.create with stream option. Update code sample and add short note on backpressure/stream chunk sizes.

Non-blocking but high-value fixes:
- Add Embeddings quick example (Python) — short 6-line snippet. Put into tutorial appendix.
- Add one-liner migration note: old 'generate' -> new 'responses.create' mapping for folks migrating from earlier SDK.
- Replace screenshot of Console with latest UI: Console -> Deployments page moved. Grab new screenshot (Ethan can take one).

Small gotchas I want to remember / notes-to-self:
- Local dev k8s manifest in repo is outdated (image tag dev-latest -> should be dev-2026-02-28). Need to either update manifest or add a local-dev script that sets proper envs.
- Dockerfile in sample-app retains apt-get update with no --no-install-recommends; bloats image. Could use slim base and multi-stage build. Mark for later.
- Tests: tutorial CI currently skips sample-app run. We should add smoke test that spins up server and hits /health. Add ticket (INF-2897).

Commands I ran (copy here for reproduction):
- node --version  # found 16 on Lina's laptop -> caused ES module issue
- nvm install 18 && nvm use 18
- docker build -t redwood/devx-sample:local -f sample-app/Dockerfile .
- REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx node sample-app/index.mjs

Slack threads / references:
- #devx: thread from 2026-03-10 about streaming rename (see link in linked_artifacts)
- Quick note to ping @Ethan for screenshot and @Lina for test case outline.

Open questions / design decisions to log:
- Should the quickstart recommend Node 20 or 18 LTS? 18 has wider install base but 20 has better ESM default behavior. My vote: require 18+, call out 20 recommended.
- For env naming, do we keep REDWOOD_API_KEY universal and derive private vs hosted by scope? Might be confusing. Suggest separate names with table in docs.

Plan for next 48h:
1) Submit two tiny PRs: sample-app package.json change + tutorial markdown tweak to clarify envs and node version. (Target: today EOD)
2) Add streaming example patch and update code blocks (Target: tomorrow morning)
3) Create a smoke-test PR for CI to run sample-app healthcheck (Target: 3/15).

Random ideas to improve discoverability of fixes:
- Add a short checklist at top of tutorial: "Before you start: Node version, Docker installed, API key" so users see this immediately.
- Add a one-click 'Run sample in cloud' button (longer-term) that points to a hosted sandbox.

Notes for PR descriptions:
- Keep changelog line: "docs: fix Node version + sample-app package.json to match ESM usage"
- For streaming change: "docs: correct streaming API sample & add short explanation of client.stream semantics"

Housekeeping:
- Tag tasks in Linear with label 'doc-bug' and priority P2 except the failing script which is P0 for launch.
- Archive this note after PRs merged.

Tiny personal TODO (non-work): pack for conference on Thurs — remind self to bring USB-C -> HDMI adapter.

End of dump.
